title: Jo Bo Ah's Next K-Drama Is an Action Drama with A Love Other Than Yours Actress - GQ Middle East

 Gracefully Killing You is scheduled for a 2027 premiere By Karishma Shetty November 12, 2026 Jo Bo Ah, in the past few years, has been silently building an impressive filmography. Her picks range from out-of-the-box projects like Tale of the Nine-Tailed to fan-favourite gems such as Destined With You . Last seen in the underrated Dear Hongrang , the Hallyu actress took a maternity break after welcoming her son in February 2026. In some exciting news, Bo Ah has just signed on to headline a new action series, which will mark her K-drama comeback…
 Jo Bo Ah's upcoming K-drama 
 Instagram content
 Jo Bo Ah is starring in Gracefully Killing You , a new TVING drama. The Hallyu actress replaces Lee Chung Ah, who was originally cast but had to step down partway through filming due to a car accident. Jo Bo Ah's agency confirmed her casting in a statement: "Jo Bo Ah has joined the drama and will participate in filming starting from October 17th. As she has become part of a great drama, she will do her utmost to deliver a great performance," according to Soompi.
 Jo Bo Ah joins an already stacked ensemble of talented actors including Kim Da Mi ( Our Beloved Summer ), Jo Aram ( A Love Other Than Yours ) and Nam Yoon Su ( Beyond Evil ), with a cameo by Kim Jae Wook ( Coffee Prince ). Joo Hwa Mi, who penned The Atypical Family , wrote the script, while Kang Eun Kyung of Gyeongseong Creature fame is the creator.
 Gracefully Killing You is a noir action drama revolving around Go Dalboon (Kim Da Mi), who dreams of being the ideal, docile wife and mother. However, soon after her divorce, Dalboon takes up a job at a suspicious organisation in an attempt to regain custody of her daughter. She goes by the code name Miss Go, embarking on a high-stakes adventure.
 Jo Bo Ah stars as Miss Lee, the team leader, while Jo Aram takes on the role of Miss Gye, the mood maker. Nam Yoon Su plays Jung Jungwon, a rookie detective, and Kim Jae Wook will be seen as Chief Cha, a reserved man whose true intentions are difficult to discern. Gracefully Killing You is scheduled to premiere in 2027.
 This story originally appeared on GQ India. 
 Karishma Shetty is an Entertainment Editor at GQ India where she covers entertainment and lifestyle, with special emphasis on celebrity, interviews, and movie & show recommendations.
